crossRefs.note: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.
My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.

Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk…

translations.web: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
translations.bsb: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
translations.kjv: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
translations.asv: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of his servants; And none of them that take refuge in him shall be condemned. Psalm 35 A Psalm of David.
